The property of the petitioner has been acquired for the benefit of Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited.
The compensation has been determined as per the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

2. The case of the petitioner is that he is entitled to compensation as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 ('the Act, 2013' for short).

sentences.text: In the course of the arguments, both the learned counsel for the petitioner and the respondents fairly submit that similar cases have been considered by this Court in W.P.No.54368/2018 and connected matters by order dated 27.02.2024 and a similar order may be passed in the instant writ petition also.
Their submission is placed on record.

4. Admittedly, the facts of the present case are similar to the petition in W.P.No.54368/2018 and connected matters and there is no reason why the order passed in the said writ NC:
2024:KHC:32219 petitions should not enure to the benefit of the petitioner in the instant writ petition.

5. Hence, the following:
ORDER The Writ Petition is disposed of in terms of the order dated 27.02.2024 passed by this Court in W.P.No.54368/2018 and connected matters and the respondents are directed to pass necessary award as per the provisions of the Act,
2013, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
Pending interlocutory applications, if any, stand disposed of.

Sd/-
